lines.t: **Verse 1**
Raging winds and roaring seas
Trying hard to swallow me
I could barely catch my breath
With fear wrapped around my chest
But somewhere in the crashing waves
I heard a whisper call my name
And though the water pulled me down
I found a love that would not drown
**Pre-Chorus**
'Cause somehow when I'm breaking
I never reach the ground
And somehow in the darkness
I'm still being carried now
**Chorus**
I am held in Your arms
You never let go of me
When the world caves in around my feet
You are my peace, You are my peace
The rain is falling down here
But You lift me high
Above the fear, above the night
You hold me close, You give me life
**Verse 2**
I look behind and now I see
Your arms were always around me
Through every road I couldn't bear
You were already there
**Pre-Chorus**
So when the mountains tremble
And all I know gives way
There's something underneath me
That never fades away
**Chorus**
I am held in Your arms
You never let go of me
When the world caves in around my feet
You are my peace, You are my peace
The rain is falling down here
But You lift me high
Above the fear, above the night
You hold me close, You give me life
**Bridge**
I don't know why You love me like You do
But mercy keeps breaking through
And every road that brought me here
Has led me deeper into Your heart
So let the waters rise again
I'll lift my eyes through every wind
Because I know, I know, I know
**Final Chorus**
I am held in Your arms
You never let go of me
Through every storm and every mystery
You are enough, You are enough
The rain is falling down here
But You lift me high
And one day every tear will dry
Until that day I'll testify
